deviations.what: The retry after the approved fix is a third fed line ('./run-model.sh' typed again), not something Enter triggers: handle_failure runs the proposal and ends the turn; /retry is a separate slash verb
deviations.reason: c22 and t5's criterion read as if approving the fix re-runs the failed command; nvsh does not, and the driver records what nvsh actually does

deviations.what: scripts/demo-render.sh passes --no-window instead of the literal --window off in t6's criterion
deviations.reason: svg-term-cli's yargs parser rejects '--window off' (unknown flag 'off'); --no-window is the same negation

deviations.what: demo-record.py uses the nvsh on PATH only when its --version matches the imported package, else a sandbox wrapper running this interpreter -m nvsh
deviations.reason: the dev box carries an older uv-tool nvsh (0.10.0, no demo adapter); preferring PATH blindly would record a broken demo

deviations.what: Every accepted line in the recording is echoed twice (nvsh$ ./run-model.shnvsh$ ./run-model.sh): readline.bash's Enter macro runs a bind -x callback before accept-line and bash redraws prompt+buffer after it
deviations.reason: real nvsh behaviour surfaced by the recording; cosmetically reads as a bug in a README demo; fixing it is a readline.bash change outside any planned task

deviations.what: The demo reply gains a {platform} placeholder filled from the request context's platform kind (e.g. dgx-spark, jetson), so each device's recording visibly names its real platform
deviations.reason: c10/h8 expect the recording to show the device's platform, but the panel header only shows harness/path/warm and the platform block is never printed; without this the three recordings would be visually identical and h8 unverifiable
